name: image-generation-mcp
description: MCP server for image generation API with support for create, edit, status check, and task management
author: Your Name

environment_variables.name: USER_OPENID
environment_variables.description: 用户认证令牌 (User authentication token)

environment_variables.name: IMAGE_API_URL
environment_variables.description: 图像生成 API 地址 (Image generation API base URL)

tools.name: image_gen_create
tools.description: 生成新的图像 (Create a new image generation task)

tools.name: image_gen_edit
tools.description: 基于参考图编辑生成图像 (Edit and generate images based on reference images)

tools.name: image_gen_status
tools.description: 检查任务状态 (Check the status of an image generation task)

tools.name: image_gen_list
tools.description: 列出所有任务 (List all image generation tasks with pagination)

tools.name: image_gen_detail
tools.description: 获取任务详情 (Get detailed information about a specific task)

tools.name: image_gen_delete
tools.description: 删除任务 (Delete one or more image generation tasks)

tools.name: image_gen_cancel
tools.description: 取消运行中的任务 (Cancel a running image generation task)

tools.name: image_gen_config
tools.description: 获取配置信息 (Get configuration information)

zh: 1. 填写必需的环境变量 USER_OPENID
2. 可选：配置 IMAGE_API_URL（如不配置则使用默认值）
3. 服务器将自动构建并启动
en: 1. Fill in the required environment variable USER_OPENID
2. Optional: Configure IMAGE_API_URL (uses default if not configured)
3. The server will automatically build and start
